about: Failures of the web-next Playwright port against a scratch build, mapped to VERIFY-V2-VISUAL defects (D1-D32, M-01..M-30). Written 13 Oct 2026 by fix-wave T6 so T7 can tell an accepted item from a regression. Not read by any test.
